feed.title: Cement & Concrete Index: daily digest
feed.subtitle: A living research index spanning cement and binder families, supplementary materials, concrete families and applications, and cross-cutting engineering topics. Daily updates; foundational coverage, not an exhaustive catalogue.

entry.title: November 25, 2026: 326 new resources
